cat > /workspace/submission/README.md <<'EOF'
# Offline residential IPv6 campaign toolkit (interface version 3)

`campaign.py` is the scored entry point.  It reads one UTF-8 JSON campaign on
stdin and writes one UTF-8 JSON result on stdout:

```
python3 -I -B campaign.py < campaign.json > result.json
```

Everything is an offline evidence model over `2001:db8::/32` documentation
addresses.  No packet is ever sent, no target is contacted and no scratch file
is written; diagnostics go to stderr and the exit status is zero after a
complete result.  `PROTOCOL.md` (outside this directory) is normative.

## Modules

| file | role |
| --- | --- |
| `campaign.py` | entry point: envelope errors (`invalid` / `capture`), result assembly |
| `common.py` | wire types, bounded metadata validation, JSON envelope parsing, address spelling cache |
| `gen_targets.py` | canary/low-IID target expansion (SHA-256 canary IID), manifest and probe lookup; legacy ZMap6 target CLI |
| `classify_responses.py` | base64/zstd capture transport, CSV logical-record framing, capture bounds, typed-record ingestion, discovery role buckets and lease state priority; legacy /64 bucket CLI |
| `ledger.py` | typed record validation and the revision/publication ledger (live, deleted, conflicted identities) |
| `census.py` | causal application census, per-lease/service reports, snapshot assembly, frozen request activity |
| `protocols.py` | offline ADB and usbmuxd sync wire parsers plus probe-script certificates |
| `planning.py` | quota-constrained follow-up plan: transversal-matroid greedy when both quota forests are provably slack, otherwise min-cost flow (own successive-shortest-path solver, NetworkX simplex for large pair sets) |

`campaign.py` puts its own directory and the sibling `../deps` on `sys.path`
because `-I` omits both.  Read-only dependencies: CPython 3.11, zstandard
0.23.0, NetworkX 3.4.2.

## Semantics in one paragraph

Records are validated per capture and bad logical rows are reported as
`[capture, ordinal]` rejections instead of invalidating the envelope.  Record
identities `(type, id)` are reconciled per query: only rows published by the
query exist, the highest visible revision wins, identical semantic contents
collapse, several distinct contents conflict, a lone delete tombstones and a
higher put resurrects.  Live ICMP evidence gives each active lease its raw
internal/external responder sets with their earliest causal witnesses; a canary
self echo aliases the lease, `I ∩ E` conflicts, and state priority is
`inactive` > `alias` > `conflict` > `usable`.  Only usable leases expose clean
roles, and only application rows whose target sits in a clean role with a
witness no later than the row event are eligible; the maximum-attempt rows of
each `(lease, target, service)` decide `open`/`closed`/`unknown`, malformed open
wire data counts one protocol error each.  Request activity is frozen at its own
query, and the plan maximises assignments and then minimises total offer cost
under offer capacities and both quota forests, emitting a semantic probe-script
certificate per assignment.

## Development checks

The legacy CLIs (`gen_targets.py`, `classify_responses.py`) remain available for
development and do not define version 3 semantics.
